notes.title: New Release Date
notes.content:
Hiya everybody!

First and foremost, the Nymphly Studios team want to just thank everyone for the attention we’ve gotten since our Steam page launch! For a group of just totally new game devs, we were so happy that Flora & Fauna broke 350 wishlists as quickly as it did.

We love you guys, and want to make sure Flora & Fauna is exactly what we envisioned when we started this project. So we wanted to announce that we’re going to be pushing back our intended launch by about a month.

The reasoning? Well, our lead artist quite literally broke their drawing hand. We wanted to make sure we give ourselves enough time to bring Flora & Fauna to life while still accounting for a safe and speedy recovery!

In the meantime, make sure to follow us on Twitter (@NymphlyStudios) for more regular updates and art of our Flora & Fauna girlies. And if you’re feeling extra generous and want to help move production along or see more behind the scenes content, check out our Patreon!

Thank you all! 

-Nymphly Studios Team
